lesson_title: Why Your Money Disappears by the 15th
hook_text: Payday on the first, broke by the fifteenth. Sound familiar? Here's the fix.
clip_script: Ayanda gets R400 a month. By the fifteenth it is gone and she is walking to school. So she makes a budget, a plan before spending. Income: R400. Needs first: taxi R200, lunch R100. Then she pays herself first: R50 into a jar. Wants last: R50 for airtime. Total: R400. It balances. End of the month, she checks: lunch was R20 cheaper, so that goes in the jar. Airtime was R20 more, so next month she buys a cheaper bundle. Plan it, check it, fix it. That is how money stops disappearing.
visual_style: A whiteboard calendar with money vanishing by the fifteenth, then a neat budget table and a savings jar filling up.
pacing: A quick problem, a step-by-step plan, then a satisfying check.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make a budget for your own pocket money.
